correctness.rationale: For a two-jump trace F=2 1_[0,ell]-1, exact cross-arc integral gives E=4ell-(4/pi)int_0^ell(ell-t)K_lambda(t)dt (lambda=rho^N), hence E''=-(4/pi)K_lambda(ell)<0, unique ell=pi. The kernel minimum K_lambda(pi) yields a sharp quadratic deficit (2/pi)(1-lambda)/(1+lambda)(ell-pi)^2. Fourier odd harmonics of half-wave give E(pi)=2pi-(8/pi)(Li_2(lambda)-Li_2(-lambda)); S'(lambda)=atanh(lambda)/lambda yields (8/pi)(1-lambda) log(1/(1-lambda)) as lambda approaches 1, and (1-rho^N)~N(1-rho) under N(1-rho)->0. Independent Poisson-integral vs Fourier comparisons passed 20 cases; all-parameter proof analytical.
